chapters.text: Everything about one client: details on the left, the timeline and next steps on the right.
Open a lead from the list. The call and WhatsApp buttons at the top dial straight away.
Log what happened: call, note, WhatsApp, meeting or email from the box on the right.
Always plan the next step (a follow-up with a date) — leads with nothing planned show up in Follow-ups.

Move the lead along with the stage bar. To close it without a sale, press Close lead at the end of the bar: Not Interested, Not Valid or Junk. A closed lead shows its status there in red; click any stage to reopen it.
The arrows next to the name (or Alt + ← / →) go to the previous or next lead of your list; Back returns to your list with the same filters.

When the client has bought, press Close deal at the top: fill in the commission form (deal value, commission %, closing date, unit, community, project, developer, agent and company share, other agents, payment structure) and press Close deal. The deal is saved as Won, a contact is made and the history carries over.
Wrote a note or call by mistake? You can delete activities you added yourself: the bin icon next to it (it asks first). Deleting other people's needs Activities → Delete.
